fields.summary: Sync retry backoff crosses 10min after long offline session
fields.description: Exponential backoff has no ceiling. After a long offline session (>3h), the next-retry interval crosses 10 min and users think sync is broken. Cap the interval at 60s and add a Retry Now button in the sync-status sidebar.

comments.body: R3 tester feedback: two testers thought Loop was broken until they force-quit + restarted the app.
Have branch fix/sync-backoff going. Cap at 60s, add explicit `syncing…` / `paused` states with a Retry Now button.
